snippet.title: PDP 10 Timesharing Basketball (1967) | The Early History of Video Games | Part 8
snippet.description:
PDP 10 Basketball is yet another early sports game written in BASIC. It was created in 1967 by Charles Bacheller of Dartmouth College - the same college BASIC was invented at. It plays very similarly to Dartmouth Championship Football, but you also now have the choice of defensive setups to go along with offensive plays. Outcomes are still random, however.

This game and many other early text-based games can be downloaded and played through Vintage BASIC: http://vintage-basic.net/index.html

Want to learn more? Read about it here:
https://obsessivegamingchronology.blogspot.com/2024/07/prehistory-viii-more-basic-sports.html
